verdicts.reason: Overturned. The discrepancy is real: PERB ¶ 1 says the Award reduced the penalty 'to a 40-day suspension,' while Award ¶ 10 imposes 45 days. The prompt asks the solver to 'Anchor each argument in specific findings of the Award and the PERB Decision.' MPD's contrary-to-law argument also depends on PERB's cursory, unexplained affirmance, which criteria 7 and 11 reward. PERB's misstatement of the very remedy it affirmed 'in all respects' is natural, record-anchored support for that argument, not an unrelated clerical audit. The criterion is worth only 6 of 60 positive points and asks for a true record fact. It is a demanding but defensible standard under the Harvey definition, so it is not defective.
